messages:
Anna: Quick handoff — I'm starting the night shift coverage at 21:00 PT. Before I fully take over, I'm going to tweak a couple of alert routing and threshold rules to reduce noise from the nightly batch run.

Anna: FYI: embedding-service has been noisy on p99 latency during the indexing window. Plan: bump p99 latency threshold from 500ms -> 900ms only for the batch window (22:00–02:00 PT) to avoid pages for expected spikes. Non-500 HTTP error alerts from the batch job will be routed to #eng-oncall (rotation) instead of #infra-alerts. If anyone disagrees, please shout now.

Anna: Command I will run (dry-run first):
```
# set temporary p99 threshold and reroute for nightly window
rwctl alert update --service embedding-service \\
  --threshold p99=900ms --window 22:00-02:00 \\
  --route "#eng-oncall" --note "nightly-batch temporary"
```

Sam L: ok with the p99 bump. Can we also add a suppression for the repeated 429s from the batch job? Those tend to spike and are non-actionable during the bulk load.

Anna: Good call. I'll add a suppression rule for 429 when occurrences >50 in 5m for the batch window.

Anna: Suppression command (will apply only 22:00-02:00):
```
rwctl alert suppress --service embedding-service --code 429 \\
  --when "occurrences>50 in 5m" --window 22:00-02:00 --reason "bulk indexing noise"
```

Priya: Heads up — there's an ongoing canary test on dedicated pool-B tonight. If pool-B flaps it can cause autoscale churn and API 503s. Please keep 503 pages at severity=1 — do NOT suppress 503s.

Anna: Understood. I will not touch 503 paging. Only muting p95/p99 latency and 429 noise for that window. 503 and 5xx errors remain routed at full severity to paging.

Mike R: pinging @Sam L — I need to swap a slot (parent pickup). Can you cover 23:00-03:00? I can take the later 03:00-07:00 if needed.

Sam L: I can take 23:00-03:00, happy to swap. @Mike R I'll DM the calendar invite.

PagerBot: Rotation change requested by Mike R. Sam L assigned 23:00-03:00.

Anna: Thanks — runbook for embedding noise is here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embedding-noise. If something escalates beyond the runbook (data loss, persistent 503s across pools), escalate to Priya (oncall manager).

Anna: I'll run the dry-run then apply the two updates (threshold + suppression) in ~2m and paste the audit output here.

DeployBot: Dry-run complete: no conflicts detected for rules update.

Anna: Applying now...

Anna: done — thresholds updated and suppression created. Audit IDs: audit_98421, suppress_98422.

Sam L: ack. Thanks for the handoff and the heads-up — I'll monitor the fanout from the batch job at 23:00 and post anything notable here. :thumbsup:

Priya: Thanks everyone. If you see cascading autoscale events, notify infra immediately and mark it Sev2 if user-facing errors increase.

Anna: All set. Leaving monitoring on. Good luck and ping in this thread for any follow-ups.
